title: Hoshino Ichika — Happy Birthday! 2024〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: One week before Ichika's birthday
School SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Miku, everyone, thank you for watching us practice again.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't mention it. This makes for good practice for us as well. See you tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yes, see you then.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: By the way, isn't it Ichika's birthday soon?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Yes, it's next week.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Next week?! Happy birthday, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's a little early for that...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe, thank you. I'll stop by on the day.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: That's sweet of you. But don't you have plans to celebrate in your world too?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's your special day, so it's fine to spend it relaxing with friends and family.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Thank you. But... I want to see you all.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Ichika...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. In that case, we'll get ready to celebrate with you here.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, how are you gonna celebrate? Are you gonna go out somewhere as a group?

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Actually, I'm planning to have a study session with my classmates.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Huh? You're studying on your birthday?!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We were actually already talking about having a study session♪

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Then, once we started sounding out interest, we ended up with more participants than we expected.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: When we compared everyone's schedules to find a day that worked, we noticed one of the days was Ichika's birthday.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: So we figured, with that many people able to come, why not combine a party with the study session?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Nice idea. Study sessions are a classic part of high school life.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Yeah. I'm excited since it's rare to gather this many people for one study session.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Excitement is important, but don't forget you're there to study.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Of course. I'm going to study hard to earn my party afterward.
Ichika's birthday
Rental Room

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ahem, greetings, gathered friends!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Thank you very much for gathering for today's “Study Session Followed By Ichika's Birthday Party”!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whoo♪

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: On this table, you will find snacks and juice earmarked for the study session. Please help yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: However! Everything on this table over here is off-limits! And who can tell me why?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Because those are for the birthday party!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line:
Ding ding ding!
By the way, there will also be cake at the party, so take care not to fill up on snacks!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Saki's really getting into this.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: She is. When I went with her to help buy stuff, she chose the snacks really carefully.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: So that means these are the snacks that made the cut☆ I can't wait to try them!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Don't forget that we're here to study.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: And now, before we begin our study session, let's hear a few words from the star of the day, Ichi!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Huh? No one told me about this...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: You can do it, Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Go, Ichika!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Hurry up, Ichi♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: *Sigh*

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Um... Thank you all for coming despite your busy schedules.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Originally, we just thought that it would be better to study as a group instead of alone...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: But so many people showed interest that we had the idea to turn it into a fun event.

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: So, uh...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: There'll be a party when we're done, so for now, let's study hard!

rows.Speaker: Saki, Emu & Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Who's working on English? Want to team up?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, me!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyone on Classics?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Over here. Let's work together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: What about math? Who'll buddy up with me?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Meee!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, me too...

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: You're also working on math, Kusanagi? Come sit with us.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah... Thank you.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Honami, can you help me?
I need to put words in the right order for this question. “Make” is acting as a causative verb here, right?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
Yes, that's right.
So, all you need to do now is find the grammatically correct word order...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Groan*
I don't get this. I'm looking at the modern translation and I still don't understand!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Which line? Wait, I don't think you have the right place.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But, isn't this the translation of that confusing “okashi” word?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The translation for that line is the one before. It's a little easy to get lost since the two lines have similar phrasing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, you're right! Shiho, Haruka, thank you!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: I feel like I'm really on top of my game today! Maybe it's because we're studying together?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Hehehe, I'm also solving these problems really quickly♪

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: I also get the feeling that I'm more focused than usual.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah... I guess it really is nice to study together.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Ooh, I have an idea! Let's race to solve ten problems!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Everyone who correctly solves ten problems will get to eat from this bag of limited-edition chocolate-smothered potato chips!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But I'm using a different workbook than you guys...

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: We're all practicing quadratic functions, so I rule that you qualify!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Whooo♪ We can do this, Nene!

rows.Speaker: Ichika
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's all solve them faster than Saki and eat all her chips.

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Heh heh... As if I'd let that happen!

rows.Speaker: Saki
rows.Line: Now, on your marks, get set...

rows.Speaker: Nene, Ichika & Emu
rows.Line:
Go!
Go☆
